user_story: As a user, I want the system to return an error when I try to get a task with a non-existent ID so that I know the task does not exist.

positive.title: Get task with non-existent ID returns error
steps: Step 1: Ensure the task ID does not exist in the system.
Step 2: Attempt to retrieve a task using the non-existent ID.
positive.expected_result: The system returns an error indicating the task does not exist.

negative.title: Get task with existing ID does not return error
steps: Step 1: Ensure the task ID exists in the system.
Step 2: Attempt to retrieve a task using the existing ID.
negative.expected_result: The system returns the task details without any error.

edge.title: Get task with malformed ID returns proper error or handling
steps: Step 1: Use an improperly formatted ID (e.g., special characters or excessively long string).
Step 2: Attempt to retrieve a task using the malformed ID.
edge.expected_result: The system returns an error or handles the malformed ID gracefully.
